targets.description: Agents to check against. Default: all supported agents.

rules.description: Severity, or [severity, options], per rule id.

agent/model-not-documented.description: Agent definition sets a model value the agent does not document

agent/subagent-model-ignored.description: Claude Code ignores the subagent's model

codex/config-invalid.description: Codex project config is not valid

cursor/legacy-cursorrules.description: .cursorrules is a legacy file that Cursor plans to deprecate

instr/windsurf-rule-too-long.description: Rule file exceeds Cascade's 12,000-character limit in JetBrains

json/invalid-syntax.description: Configuration file is not valid JSON

mcp/env-syntax-mismatch.description: MCP configuration uses another agent's variable syntax

mcp/gemini-server-name.description: Gemini CLI MCP server name contains an underscore

mcp/gemini-trust.description: Gemini CLI MCP server is trusted and skips tool confirmations

mcp/literal-secret.description: Configuration file contains a literal credential

mcp/url-without-type.description: MCP server has a "url" but no "type"

risk/hidden-unicode.description: File contains invisible or text-reordering Unicode characters

risk/remote-script-execution.description: Command downloads a script and runs it in one step

settings/auto-approve-project-mcp.description: Settings approve every project MCP server automatically

skill/body-too-long.description: Skill body is longer than recommended

skill/broken-reference.description: Skill links to a missing file or outside its directory

skill/name-missing.description: Skill name is missing or empty

ignore.description: Globs, relative to the scanned directory, of files to skip.

overrides.description: Severity changes for files matching `files`. Later entries win.
